answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay: a sponsor stakes 60 POA to vouch for a newcomer on its voyage; the newcomer starts at zero, earning it by work, losing 5% per idle epoch. A marble ledger lists every sponsor; an opal seal marks unslashed sponsors. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA; each fake must keep working or bleed reputation; one cheat slashes its sponsor. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps full earnings.
